query:
UPDATE scratch
                    SET payload = $1,
                        revision = revision + 1,
                        updated_at = datetime('now', 'subsec')
                    WHERE id = $2 AND scratch_type = $3 AND revision = $4
                    RETURNING
                        id              as "id!: Uuid",
                        scratch_type,
                        payload,
                        revision        as "revision!: i64",
                        created_at      as "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>",
                        updated_at      as "updated_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
